[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Kelly Springer consignment settlement — 6 cacao bags sold, QR batch 2024SA_20251227 reconciled to Venmo $102
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://agroverse.shop/agl4
  - https://edgar.truesight.me/agroverse/qr-code-check?qr_code=2024SA_20251227_31
  
  Details:
  ## What this covers
  
  Retailer Kelley/Kelly Springer ("Love Wisdom Power") reached out 2026-10-12 reporting 6 bags of ceremonial cacao sold that day, and asked for a Venmo handle to remit proceeds. She paid $102.00 on 2026-10-13 (memo: "Cocoa Blessings") = 6 x $17.00, exactly the consignment cost price per bag.
  
  ## Work performed
  
  1. Resolved 7 uploaded images to 6 unique bags: one file was byte-identical duplicate of another (md5 5b4ff551…), and one image had failed to upload in the original batch (later supplied).
  2. Machine-decoded 4 of 6 QR codes directly (zbar/cv2, with crop+upscale fallbacks); the remaining 2 were read from the printed human-readable label via vision, as their QR squares were not machine-decodable. Provenance is flagged in each ledger event's notes.
  3. Verified all six codes exist in the ledger as MINTED with Manager = Kelly Springer, confirming this as consignment sell-through rather than new-retailer onboarding.
  4. Submitted 6 SALES EVENTs (one per QR per batch-sales SOP sec 0), Sales price $17.00 each = $102.00, Sold by "Kelly Springer" populated explicitly.
  5. Verified all six QR codes flipped to SOLD with Owner email set.
  
  ## Reconciliation
  
  | QR code | Price | Ledger status (post) |
  |---|---|---|
  | 2024SA_20251227_31 | 17.00 | SOLD |
  | 2024SA_20251227_28 | 17.00 | SOLD |
  | 2024SA_20251227_29 | 17.00 | SOLD |
  | 2024SA_20251227_30 | 17.00 | SOLD |
  | 2024SA_20251227_18 | 17.00 | SOLD |
  | 2024SA_20251227_19 | 17.00 | SOLD |
  | **Total** | **102.00** | Venmo received 102.00 — reconciles to zero |
  
  ## Note on seller-name spelling
  
  Ledger uses "Kelly Springer"; the retailer signs "Kelley Springer". Spelling was preserved as-is in the ledger to avoid breaking the partner join that previously caused her sales to be dropped.
  
  ## Relevant context
  
  Per PARTNER_DEEP_DIVE_METHODOLOGY.md this is the highest-verified consignment partner on record (prior cycle: 30 bags received, 12 sold, 2 returned, reconciled to zero). A known tooling gap means her prior sales were silently dropped by sync_partners_velocity.py when "Sold By" was empty while "Reporter Name" was populated — leaving her 12-month sales average reading 0 despite being the top seller. "Sold by" was populated on all six events above to avoid repeating that.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
